note: Frozen Top Reads trial rules. A rule only counts signals FIRST fired strictly after its frozen_at. rule_hash covers id, version, predicate and frozen_at. Changing any of them means a new rule id with a new frozen_at and rule_hash; build_topreads_ledger.py refuses a registry whose hash does not match, and refuses a frozen_at or version that differs from the one its ledger first saw. Set "retired": true by hand to retire a rule.
